ItemID: 1; Title: Sali 10 Pack Ceramic Flap Disc 60 Grit 4.5" x 7/8 Inch Sanding Disc Bevel Type #29 Premium and Industrial Grade Angle Grinder Grinding Wheel High Performance Edge Grinding; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for smoothing cut metal edges alongside my recent cutting wheels; I would check grinder compatibility before choosing.
ItemID: 2; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful disposable gloves for messy adhesive and epoxy work, both of which appear in my recent projects.
ItemID: 3; Title: Adhesive Guru Spray Foam Gun Cleaner 15,8 oz, Expanding Foam Gun Cleaner, Insulation Polyurethane and PU Sealant Remover for Pro Dispensing Gun, 1 Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My adhesive projects do not establish a need for a specialized expanding-foam gun cleaner.
ItemID: 4; Title: OVERTURE PLA Filament 1.75mm PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1kg Cardboard Spool (2.2lbs), Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03mm, Fit Most FDM Printer (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on hardware and fabrication supplies, with no current indication that I need 3D printer filament.
ItemID: 5; Title: Coolneon Brass Rods 3/16 x 12",6PCS,Knife Handle Material,Knife Handle Pins,Brass Round Stock,Knife Pins,Brass Pins for Knife Handles Scales,for Hardware,Novelty,DIY,Hobby,Model Car Plane Boat Ship.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Brass stock interests me for small fabrication projects, and my recent metal drill bits and caliper would help work it accurately.
ItemID: 6; Title: PLA Silk Silver 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, RongTong 3D Printing Silk PLA 1kg/2.2lb Spool Printing Material, Silky Shiny Metallic Luster Surface Filament, Fits Most FDM 3D Printers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A metallic finish is not enough to make this useful without a current filament-printing project.
ItemID: 7; Title: #4 x 5/8" Pan Head Phillps Drive Self Tapping Screws, 304 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Pan Head Wood Screws, Sheet Metal Tek Screws, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Small stainless self-tapping screws fit my repeated interest in fastening and sheet-metal work; I would choose these for practical assembly jobs.
ItemID: 8; Title: NOVA3D 8k Photopolymer Resin Rapid 405nm UV Curing Standard Resin High Precision Non Brittle for LCD 3D Printer Grey 1000g; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tabletop epoxy interest does not imply a need for UV-curing printer resin or ownership of a compatible printer.
ItemID: 9; Title: Potlimepan EPDM Non-Adhesive Sponge Foam Roll, Perfect Cosplay Padding, DIY Project Sheet, Multi-Function Soundproof Foam Sheet, Easy to Cut (1/4" T x 13" W x 80" L, 1); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Potentially useful project material, but I do not have a specific padding or soundproofing need right now.
ItemID: 10; Title: OELFFOW IP67 Button Switch Outdoor Waterproof Box Red Emergency Button with Protective Cover Anti-misoperation Switch(AC/DC 6A-110V/3A-240V/2.5A-380V); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This requires a specific electrical-control application that my recent mechanical projects do not establish.
